verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent building blocks: Azure RBAC gives fine-grained access control scoped to subscriptions [azure-docs-10, azure-docs-11], and budget alerts act as a spend guardrail [azure-docs-13]. Nothing documents an actual isolation pattern for keeping experiments away from production. Missing for 10: documented multi-subscription/management-group hierarchy or sandbox patterns, policy-based guardrails (e.g. Azure Policy or landing zones), explicit dev/prod separation guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
